caption:
The neon rain slicked against my skin like a cold, electric caress. 🌃 They said the data was hot, but they didn't tell me the heat would be this intense. My heart hammered against my ribs, a frantic rhythm in the humid air. I adjusted my collar, the synthetic lace brushing against my chest, and felt the weight of the drive—a heavy, illicit secret. The hum of the city was a low drone, but my pulse was louder. Every shadow felt like a hunter, every flickering light a spotlight. I’m not just carrying a drive; I’m carrying a revolution. Or maybe just my own undoing. Either way, I’ve never felt more alive!
